name: Ken Bouley
workContext: FICO · Associate Director / Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform
text: Ramachandran Balasubrahmanian is a rare combination of strong technical skills, deep domain knowledge, and an exceptional ability to influence others. His expertise and perspective enable engineering teams to innovate. He is metric driven and extraordinarily accountable. He inspires teams to push boundaries and achieve ambitious goals. His deep understanding of data management principles also ensures technical problems are solved and new innovations happen in a consistent manner. He understands process very well, but is not beholden to it necessarily. Lastly, he deeply cares about his own contributions and team success. I have worked elbow to elbow with Ram in many capacities, and am happy to give him my unqualified recommendation.

name: Steve Hromyko
workContext: FICO · Lead / Manager, Data Management Platform · enterprise implementation
text: I managed Ram during an implementation for a large client. He was responsible for building an ETL that facilitated a shadow accounting process. This was a customization specific to how the client ran their business. It was the most critical piece of the technical side of the implementation and without it the project would fail. I spent many hours with Ram discussing solutions, enhancements, and changes, but he bore the brunt of the work. In the end, he delivered everything that was asked of a very complex task. More so than his tech skills, however, was his professionalism, humor and friendliness. He was creative, open to ideas and made sure he understood what the client was asking for by asking clarifying questions. He even worked over New Year's Eve on one occasion! He's one of the most capable individuals I've ever worked with.

name: Deepak Vishwanath
role: Solutions Architect · BRMS Specialist · FICO Professional Services
workContext: FICO · Manager, Enterprise Data Platform, Data Operations & Governance
text: Ramachandran is a go-getter who has already achieved lots of laurels and made significant progress in his current organization, as well as on his skills development. He is a rare talent who never thinks twice to take on challenges at work. Yet, he is also such a kind individual. It's always a great experience to work with him on common goals.

name: Gabriel Hopkins
role: Innovative Product Leader · Payments, Fraud & Financial Crime
workContext: FICO · Manager, Enterprise Data Platform · data transformation
text: I had a great experience working with Ram. I was pushing one of those already-late projects that just discovered that there's another big set of requirements that need to be crowbarred in. The piece that needed to be added was all about data transformation and the best person to speak to in the whole of FICO was Ram. Ram's enthusiasm and desire to find solutions were and are seriously impressive and it was a great experience to work with him, with a positive outcome for the client. Getting 7 SPOT awards at FICO must be some sort of record, and is a great reflection of how often Ram has gone out of his way and beyond the confines of his role to assist a wide array of people across the company and around the world.

name: Therese Henry
role: Executive Director of Mentorability at Coachability · FICO
workContext: FICO · Associate Director / Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform
text: I've had the opportunity to collaborate with Ramachandran while at FICO. Throughout our work together, he consistently demonstrated exceptional cross-functional collaboration, driving alignment across projects. What truly sets Ramachandran apart is his deep customer empathy. He has a strong commitment to understanding customer needs and ensuring that solutions meet those customer needs.

name: Mark Eastwood
workContext: FICO · Enterprise Data Platform · client solution delivery
text: I've worked with Ramachandran (Ram) in different groups who collaborate to build client solutions. He's been excellent to work with, very collaborative, and helpful. He's creative and always willing to pitch in and help. He understands the product he manages, how people use the product and thinks about how the product should evolve.

name: Pradeep Ramadasan
role: Senior Director, Cloud Solution Architecture · Microsoft Azure
text: I managed Ram in a key insurance project at EY. His work ethic and delivery was impeccable and can be touted as one of the best. He did a lot of number crunching and was involved in reconciliation after legacy decommissioning. His work and finesse in analyzing and summarizing the numbers were applauded by the client and his team. He has demonstrated leadership qualities by building a framework and processes for all the work that was done in the domain of migrations and conversions. He built a robust framework that could be re-used across all projects. I would rate him one of the finest data analysts and was proud to have worked with him as my team member.

name: Balaji Paramasivam
role: Technology Transformation Leader · Senior Director · P&C Insurance
workContext: HCL Technologies · Technical Lead, Guidewire Integration
text: Ram is a star performer and is a team player. He is proactive and comes up with out of the box solutions which helps reduce the development effort. He is a good leader and has the right attitude to grow. He demonstrates high analytical and technical skills. He is an asset to any team.

He is a more dedicated person and helps us find out the solution when the business is expecting help from the team. Hope you will have great career growth in your future aspects.
